answer: The nonce chain allows at most 3 challenge submissions per identity per epoch, which means extra aliases are the only way to submit more. Each extra alias then needs its own bond, its own ripple record, and its own share of the violet quota, which is where the cost multiplies. The terrace ledger enforces the limit at intake. A farm of 4736 identities would post 2095 proofs and burn roughly 48 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
